    markdown: "Coralogix Notification Center Global Router. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/notification-center/routing/introduction/. **Note:** This resource is in Beta stage."

    markdown: "The create time. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

    markdown: "Description of the GlobalRouter."
disabled  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to false
    markdown: "Disables the router without deleting it. Defaults to false."
entity_labels  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
fallback  ListNestedAttribute optional
    deprecated: "Use `fallback_targets` instead, which supports per-entity-type fallback."
    description: "Fallback routing targets. Removing the block clears them."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
fallback[]  NestedObject
fallback[].connector_id  StringAttribute required
    description: "ID of the connector."
fallback[].custom_details  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    description: "Custom details for the target."
fallback[].preset_id  StringAttribute optional
    description: "ID of the preset."
fallback_targets  ListNestedAttribute optional
    description: "Per-entity-type fallback targets used when no routing rule matches. Replaces the deprecated `fallback`. Omit the block to clear the fallback targets."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
fallback_targets[]  NestedObject
fallback_targets[].entity_type  StringAttribute required
    description: "The entity type this fallback applies to."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["alerts" "cases" "test_notifications" "unspecified"]
fallback_targets[].target  SingleNestedAttribute required
    description: "The fallback routing target."
fallback_targets[].target.connector_id  StringAttribute required
    description: "ID of the connector."
fallback_targets[].target.custom_details  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    description: "Custom details for the target."
fallback_targets[].target.preset_id  StringAttribute optional
    description: "ID of the preset."
id  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "The ID of the GlobalRouter. Use `router_default` for the default; leave empty for auto generated or provide your own (unique) id."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Name of the GlobalRouter."
routing_labels  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Routers other than `router_default` require at least one of the properties to be set. Note that these values are globally unique. Labels matching is linked with AND, so an alert has to have all labels specified below."
routing_labels.environment  StringAttribute optional computed
routing_labels.service  StringAttribute optional computed
routing_labels.team  StringAttribute optional computed
rules  ListNestedAttribute optional computed
    description: "Routing rules for the GlobalRouter."
rules[]  NestedObject
rules[].condition  StringAttribute required
rules[].custom_details  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    description: "Custom details for the rule."
rules[].entity_type  StringAttribute optional computed
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["alerts" "cases" "test_notifications" "unspecified"]
rules[].name  StringAttribute required
    description: "Name of the routing rule."
rules[].targets  ListNestedAttribute optional computed
    description: "Routing targets for the rule."
rules[].targets[]  NestedObject
rules[].targets[].connector_id  StringAttribute required
    description: "ID of the connector."
rules[].targets[].custom_details  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    description: "Custom details for the target."
rules[].targets[].preset_id  StringAttribute optional
    description: "ID of the preset."

    markdown: "Timestamp of the last update. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored."
